message.description: What went wrong or what is being asked, in plain words: what was attempted, what happened, and what was expected. Include exact error text if there is any.

category.description: bug: a Cedar tool or agent failed or behaved wrongly. confused: the user or agent could not tell how something works. feature_request: a capability that is missing. Default other.

runId.description: agent_executions run id the report is about, if any.

conversationId.description: Conversation (deal) id the report is about, if any.

agentId.description: Saved agent id the report is about, if any.

source.description: The page or context where this feedback originated (e.g. 'gallery')

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
